notes.title: Urban Myth Dissolution Center Ver 1.3.0 Update Details
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for playing [i]Urban Myth Dissolution Center[/i]![/p][p][/p][p]Today, we’ve released Version 1.3.0 for the Steam version.[/p][p][/p][h1]■ Ver. 1.3.0 Update Details[/h1][h2]● New Features[/h2][h3]Select Chapter[/h3][p]You can now start the game from any chapter via the Select Chapter option on the title screen.[/p][previewyoutube="2LDxj4sbe_A;full"][/previewyoutube][p]* The Chapter Select feature becomes available after clearing the game.[/p][p]* If you cleared the game before updating to Ver. 1.3.0, you can access this feature by selecting “SET COMPLETION FLAG” from the options menu on the title screen.[/p][p][/p][h3]Adjust Character Movement Speed[/h3][p]You can now increase the character’s movement speed.[/p][previewyoutube="DGNTtIV4maU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Adjust Text Display Speed[/h3][p]You can freely adjust the speed at which text is displayed.[/p][previewyoutube="BUQB_-xo-UY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Auto Text Display[/h3][p]Text can now advance automatically without needing to click a button.[/p][previewyoutube="ZLYOnYqmH6M;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Fast Forward Dialogue (Unlocked Post-Clear)[/h3][p]After completing the game, you can now skip dialogue at any time during subsequent playthroughs.[/p][previewyoutube="m38Y3GgsDVU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Carry Over Discovered Urban Myth & Database Entries[/h3][p]When starting a second playthrough, you can carry over the urban myths and database entries collected in your first run.[/p][previewyoutube="NfsV0_qIKJQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]● Minor bug fixes and text corrections[/h2][p][/p][p]Once again, thank you all for playing![/p][p][/p][p]The development team is working hard to make Urban Myth Dissolution Center even more enjoyable. We truly appreciate your continued support![/p]

notes.title: Urban Myth Dissolution Center Ver 1.0.3 Update Details
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Urban Myth Dissolution Center!

On April 15, 2025, at 1:00 PST we plan to release version 1.0.3 on Steam.

We appreciate your patience, and with this update, Steam Deck users will now be able to use cloud saves.

However, [b]if you usually play on a Steam Deck, please launch the game on your Steam Deck at least once after 1:00 PST on April 15 and trigger an auto-save before playing on another device.
[/b]If you start the game on another device before doing so, the save data on that device may overwrite the Steam Deck's save data. Please proceed with caution.

[h3]Changes in Ver 1.0.3[/h3]
・Bug fixes
・Typo corrections
・Fixed an issue where uncollected information was displayed in the notebook prematurely

Once again, we appreciate the love and support from everyone who has played the game!
Our development team is working hard to make Urban Myth Dissolution Center even more enjoyable. Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: [Notice and Apology] Regarding Cloud Save Issues in Steam Version
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support of Urban Myth Dissolution Center.

We have confirmed an issue with the cloud save functionality in the Steam version, which was released on February 13, 2025.

Details of the Issue
Cloud saves are not functioning properly between Steam Deck and PC, resulting in the following problems:
-When playing on Steam Deck, and then launching the game on PC with the same account, save data does not sync.
-Likewise, when playing on PC, and then launching the game on Steam Deck, save data does not sync.
-This issue occurs in both the demo and full version.
-If you are only playing on PC without switching to Steam Deck, cloud saves will function as expected.

Important Note:
Save data from the demo version released between October 14 – November 7, 2024, cannot be transferred to the full version.
Save data from the demo version released on January 20, 2025, can be transferred to the full version.

Current Status
We are actively investigating the cause of this issue and will provide updates as soon as we have more information.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience as we work towards a resolution. 

Thank you for your continued support and understanding.
